description: This file contains unit tests for focus index mapping logic in an Android TV application. It specifically tests how focus is mapped from one row to another in a grid, handling boundary conditions, clamping, and boundary cases for D-Pad navigation.

classes.name: FocusMappingTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying focus index mapping logic in a UI grid for Android TV.

methods.name: computeTargetIndex
methods.description: Helper function that computes the new focus index when navigating upward in a grid, with boundary checks and clamping.

methods.name: `2nd row to 1st row maps within bounds`
methods.description: Test case for normal upward focus movement within bounds.

methods.name: `2nd row to 1st row clamps when index exceeds`
methods.description: Test case where the current index exceeds the number of items in the upper row, requiring clamping.

methods.name: `upper row empty returns -1`
methods.description: Test case for when the upper row has no items, expecting a return of -1.

methods.name: `negative current index coerces to zero`
methods.description: Test cases for negative current index inputs, which should be coerced to zero.

methods.name: `3rd row to 2nd row general mapping`
methods.description: Test cases for generic upward focus movement including clamping when upper row has fewer items.

methods.name: `4th row to 3rd row general mapping`
methods.description: Additional cases testing focus movement with larger indices and boundary conditions.
